title: Efficacy of Modified Ketogenic Diet (Atkins) in Management of Epilepsy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether patients with uncontrolled epilepsy can follow a low carbohydrate diet long-term and if so, how will that diet affect their seizures
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:medically refractory partial epilepsy financial ability to pay for higher priced food
